name: Do you repair sliding door latches for all brands and types of doors?

mainEntity.name: Do you repair sliding door latches for all brands and types of doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, City Dweller, LLC has experience repairing latches for a wide variety of sliding door brands and types, including patio doors, pocket doors, and wardrobe doors. Our technicians are familiar with common manufacturers and diverse latch mechanisms. While some antique or highly specialized latches might require custom solutions or specific part ordering, we strive to accommodate all repair needs within our service areas of the Bay Area, Pacifica, and surrounding communities.
acceptedAnswer.description: We repair latches for most sliding door brands and types, including patio, pocket, and wardrobe doors, across our Bay Area service areas.
